name: qnalog
description: Obsidian plugin: record and transcribe conversations, then turn them into structured Markdown notes.

scripts.build: npm run check:versions && npm run check:undefined-symbols && npm run check:domain-boundaries && npm run typecheck:core && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/check-mobile-bundle-load.mjs && node scripts/check-plugin-onload.mjs && node scripts/check-merge-pipeline.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:mainline-isolation && npm run check:legacy-prefixes && npm run check:settings-map
scripts.verify:push: npm run verify && npm run check:bundle-consistency
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Q&A Log Team
